description: Development Pipeline Template is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. This dataset provides a template for use by jurisdictions within the San Francisco Bay Area to document major projects in their development pipeline. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Development. Its tags are development pipeline, projects, permits, construction, basis. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Commission. The portal shows 2019-08-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
